title: The CCMS release interface, the harness pack and the case-state screen are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 18, 41 and 43; legacy RWB-E3-017 sections 12, 13 and 15
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the interface code, transport, message or file layout and test endpoint of the CCMS outbound interface that carries the release instruction, the outbound item and delivery evidence the harness should read, the fixture that carries the CCMS release confirmation for R-SET-21, the data product code that carries the v_ace_account balance, the wave 2 harness environment, the seeding set, the feature flag key for the journey, the screen ID that shows the case states COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED, PLAN_COMPLETED and CASE_CLOSED_SETTLED, or the evidence format and its retention.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners and operations only, and the legacy key gives the business values and the states only
proposed: Agree the CCMS interface config and its test endpoint with the integration owner, publish the R-SET-21 confirmation fixture, name the account data product code, and agree the wave 2 harness pack, seeding and evidence format with QA; build against the fakes until then

title: The re-appraisal harness pack, the fixed clock, the SVAF interface and the evidence format are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 §R7.2 and §R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 16, 41 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slide 21; legacy RWB-E3-026 §12 and §15
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the fixed clock value and the JOB-19 window control for a repeatable monthly re-appraisal run, the SVAF interface ID and its file pattern with the order-file fixture contents, the field ID of the one_year_rule_applied input flag of R-DIS-15, the harness environment, the data seeding set, the evidence format and retention, the pass or fail gate, or the production feature switch that guards the cycle in rwb-asset. The legacy story gives the business values, the states, the messages and the screens only, and the architecture extract gives JOB-19 as a monthly Schedule on rwb-asset without a test window.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners and operations only
proposed: Agree the fixed clock, the JOB-19 window control, the SVAF interface ID and its fixture, the harness seeding and the evidence format with QA and the rwb-asset and rwb-integration owners at the wave 2 entry check

title: The wave 2 journey harness environment, seeded data, evidence format and release gate are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 section R7.2 and section R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13 to 20, 41 to 44 and 46; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slide 13; ownership.json api and tables
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the harness repository, environment and namespace for the wave 2 end-to-end journey, its seeded case and seeded proceeds, treatment, asset and deviation identifiers, its fixed business date outside the case examples the source documents use, the evidence format and retention, the wave gate name and any threshold beyond all-green, the gateway-bff composite route path and merge order the harness composes through, or the rwb-deviation read operation that the ownership map does not list as a GET path.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners, tables and operations only, and Architecture v5 slide 46 names contract tests, replay tests and a daily journey smoke workflow without giving the harness pack, the environment or the gate
proposed: Agree the wave 2 harness pack, the seeded data, the fixed business date, the evidence format and retention and the all-green gate with QA at the wave entry check, publish the gateway-bff composite route with RWB-PLT-N001-CON, and name the rwb-deviation read operation with RWB-S8-E2015-APP
